steps.name: vendor-enum-contract
steps.summary: Generate or vendor the five Postgres enum member sets from the authoritative enum.prisma, using @map values.

steps.name: target-row-shape
steps.summary: Declare the parser_output_asset_enrich / parser_output_exposures_enrich column sets and their types.

steps.name: id-derivation
steps.summary: Port uuidv5 instance-scoped derivation and canonical content hashing; one code path.

steps.name: mapping-engine
steps.summary: Generic engine applying per-vendor mapping data; verifies declared field reads against the manifest at load time.

steps.name: vendor-mapping-data
steps.summary: Falcon asset + findings mapping, and Tenable findings mapping, as data only.

steps.name: measure
steps.summary: Run both lanes end to end; report throughput, peak RSS under a heap cap, enum-cast rejects, and identity collision counts.
